bounded_slice.question: Can an externally visible effect be made conditional on successful Chat-native CAS/checkpoint readback without richer-mode, protected/manual execution, finite quota, or added cost?
bounded_slice.tested_scope: A single scheduled-Chat execution chain with a durable repository checkpoint/CAS before one target side-effect call, followed by a durable completion receipt. No claim is made for arbitrary distributed transactions beyond this ordering model.
bounded_slice.result: Conditional ordering is achievable: the target effect call can be issued only after the checkpoint/CAS write succeeds and exact readback confirms the intended reservation state. However, generic exactly-once completion is not achievable for an arbitrary non-idempotent target effect: a crash after the target effect succeeds but before the completion receipt creates an ambiguous replay window. The ambiguity is closed only when the target effect itself is the atomic durable state mutation, or the target API supplies a stable idempotency key and/or a queryable effect identity that lets the next recurrence determine whether the effect already committed before retrying.
bounded_slice.verifier_condition: Accept this architecture only for effect surfaces with atomic-state identity or stable dedupe/query semantics; otherwise classify the residual crash-window as unresolved rather than handing it to richer-mode/protected/manual execution.
bounded_slice.positive_claim_scope: pre-effect conditional ordering after durable readback
bounded_slice.negative_claim_scope: generic exactly-once semantics for arbitrary non-idempotent effects
